The '''Battle of Episol''' was a minor engagement between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces loyal to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] and the [[Kathol Republic Navy]] in the [[Episol system]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].

==Set up==
In 8 ABY, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Lialic II]]'', operating under the name ''Lance of Endor'' and posing as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel, entered the Episol system. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rolf Treidum]] made a number of unreasonable demands, including the annexation of all Republic worlds, a fifty percent tax on all products and resources, the forced sterilization of all colonists, and the replacement of elected representatives with appointed New Republic officials. Giving them an impossible deadline to meet, Treidum left the system and reported back to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].

Sarne, seeing a chance to delay the ''[[FarStar]]'' from following him through the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], deliberately responded with a message on a wide beam transmission that the ''FarStar'' was sure to pick up and decrypt. Sure enough, the crew of the ''FarStar'' intercepted and decoded the transmission, and set course for the Episol system immediately, hoping to find and engage Sarne.

==The battle==
The ''Lialic II'' returned to the Episol system to find that the Kathol Republic had not complied to Treidum's demands, much as they had expected. Due to their "failure", Treidum attacked, destroying one of the navy's vessels, and crippling another, the [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Bravado III]]''. Treidum had planned to hit several other targets, but the ''FarStar'' arrived in the system. Treidum ordered the ''Lialic II'' into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving the ''FarStar'' to face the Republic.

==Aftermath==
The ''FarStar'' arrived in the system, and intercepted a distress call from the crippled ''Bravado III''. Moving in to assist, they were confused to learn that captain of the vessel believed them to be in league with whoever had attacked them. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Willa Udine]] of the ''Bravado III'' kept the crew of the ''FarStar'' talking while six other vessels of the Kathol Republic Navy arrived. Surrounding the ''FarStar'', fleet commander [[Hendric Faile]] called for the surrender of the New Republic vessel so the crew could answer for the crimes of their "sister ship", the ''Lance of Endor''. Captain [[Kaiya Adrimetrum|Adrimetrum]], not wanting to antagonize the Kathol Republic and to clear the New Republic's name, surrendered. The ship and crew were taken to the capital of the Kathol Republic, [[Dayark]] to stand trial.
